text: Hydra Barrier Cream is a lightweight gel-cream moisturiser that helps keep skin hydrated and supports the skin's moisture barrier. It is designed as the final step of a daily skincare routine, morning and night. The formula combines ceramide, panthenol and squalane with a hyaluronic acid complex. It contains no added fragrance and no essential oils, and it is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
Product type: Moisturising cream (cosmetic product)
Volume: 50 mL
Texture: Gel-cream, absorbs quickly, non-sticky finish
Packaging: Airless pump tube
List price: S$48.00
Live broadcast price: S$36.00 (25% off list price, during the live broadcast only)
Live set price: S$62.00 for Hydra Barrier Cream 50 mL + Deep Hydration Ampoule 30 mL
Skin types: All skin types. Recommended for dry, combination and sensitive skin
Free from: Added fragrance, essential oils, ethanol (denatured alcohol), mineral oil
pH: 5.5 (plus or minus 0.5)
Shelf life: 30 months unopened. Use within 12 months after opening
Made in: Republic of Korea
Panthenol: 5%. Helps relieve the feeling of dryness.
Squalane: 3%. Softens skin and helps reduce moisture loss.
Ceramide NP: 1%. Helps support the skin's moisture barrier.
Sodium Hyaluronate (3 molecular weights): 1%. Attracts and holds moisture on the skin surface.
Allantoin: 0.2%. Helps soothe the feeling of dryness.

1. Use morning and night as the last step of your skincare routine. 2. If you use Deep Hydration Ampoule, apply the ampoule first and wait until it is absorbed. 3. Pump one to two times and spread evenly over the face and neck. 4. In the morning, apply sunscreen after the cream. The cream can be used under makeup.

In-house study, 32 participants aged 20 to 49 with dry or combination skin, 4 weeks, twice-daily use. Skin hydration measured with a corneometer. Self-assessment by questionnaire. Patch test: 48 hours under dermatologist supervision.
Skin hydration immediately after one application: +38% versus before application. (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Skin hydration 24 hours after one application: +21% versus before application. (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Participants who said skin felt less dry after 2 weeks: 29 of 32 (91%). (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Irritation reactions in 48-hour patch test: 0 of 32 participants. (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If the product gets into the eyes, rinse with water.
Stop using and consult a dermatologist if redness, swelling or itching appears during or after use.
Do not apply to broken or damaged skin.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store below 30°C and away from direct sunlight.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding: the product has not been specifically tested on pregnant or breastfeeding women. Customers who are pregnant or breastfeeding should consult their doctor before use.

Approved claims: Helps keep skin hydrated for up to 24 hours.* Helps support the skin's moisture barrier. Helps relieve the feeling of dryness. Suitable for sensitive skin. Patch tested with no irritation reactions in our in-house test.* Lightweight gel-cream texture that absorbs quickly. No added fragrance and no essential oils.

Claims not approved: Repairs, heals or cures damaged skin. Treats eczema, dermatitis, acne or any skin disease. Removes wrinkles or reverses skin ageing. Permanent results, or results without continued use. Completely safe for everyone, or safe during pregnancy. Works like a medicine or a prescription product. Comparative or superlative claims, such as "the best moisturiser in Singapore".
Q: How much is it? A: List price S$48.00. Live broadcast price S$36.00. Set with Deep Hydration Ampoule S$62.00.
Q: Is it suitable for oily skin? A: Yes. The gel-cream texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly. Use a smaller amount on oily areas.
Q: Does it have fragrance? A: No added fragrance and no essential oils. A faint natural scent from the raw materials may be noticeable.
Q: Can men use it? A: Yes. It is suitable for all skin types and all users.
Q: Can I use it under makeup? A: Yes. Apply sunscreen after the cream, then makeup.
Q: Can I use it while pregnant or breastfeeding? A: The product has not been specifically tested on pregnant or breastfeeding women. Please consult your doctor before use.

Deep Hydration Ampoule is a concentrated watery-gel ampoule that delivers instant hydration and helps skin look more radiant and even-toned. It is applied after toner and before moisturiser. The formula is built on centella asiatica leaf water and combines 4% niacinamide with a hyaluronic acid complex of five molecular weights. It contains no added fragrance and no essential oils.
Product type: Ampoule serum (cosmetic product)
Volume: 30 mL
Texture: Watery gel, absorbs quickly
Packaging: Glass bottle with dropper
List price: S$42.00
Live broadcast price: S$32.00 (about 24% off list price, during the live broadcast only)
Live set price: S$62.00 for Deep Hydration Ampoule 30 mL + Hydra Barrier Cream 50 mL
Skin types: All skin types. Recommended for dry and dull-looking skin
Free from: Added fragrance, essential oils, ethanol (denatured alcohol)
Shelf life: 30 months unopened. Use within 12 months after opening
Made in: Republic of Korea
Centella Asiatica Leaf Water: 50% (formula base). Base of the formula in place of plain water.
Niacinamide: 4%. Helps skin look more radiant and even-toned.
Sodium Hyaluronate (5 molecular weights): 2%. Delivers instant hydration.
Beta-Glucan: 1%. Helps soothe the feeling of dryness.
Panthenol: 1%. Helps relieve the feeling of dryness.

1. Use morning and night after cleansing and toner. 2. Apply two to three drops to the face and pat gently until absorbed. 3. Follow with Hydra Barrier Cream or your usual moisturiser. 4. If you are new to niacinamide, start with once a day for the first week.

In-house study, 30 participants aged 20 to 49 with dry or dull-looking skin, 4 weeks, twice-daily use. Skin hydration measured with a corneometer. Self-assessment by questionnaire. Patch test: 48 hours under dermatologist supervision.
Skin hydration immediately after one application: +45% versus before application. (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Participants who said skin looked more radiant after 4 weeks: 26 of 30 (87%). (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Participants who said skin tone looked more even after 4 weeks: 24 of 30 (80%). (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
Irritation reactions in 48-hour patch test: 0 of 30 participants. (In-house test. Cosmetic effects only.)
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If the product gets into the eyes, rinse with water.
Sensitive skin may feel a mild, temporary tingling. Stop using and consult a dermatologist if redness, swelling or itching continues.
Do not apply to broken or damaged skin.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store below 30°C and away from direct sunlight. Close the dropper tightly after use.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding: the product has not been specifically tested on pregnant or breastfeeding women. Customers who are pregnant or breastfeeding should consult their doctor before use.

Approved claims: Delivers instant hydration. Helps skin look more radiant and even-toned with continued use. Helps reduce the look of fine dryness lines. Helps soothe the feeling of dryness. 26 of 30 participants said their skin looked more radiant after 4 weeks.* No added fragrance and no essential oils.

Claims not approved: Removes wrinkles or reverses skin ageing. Whitens skin, or permanently changes skin colour. Treats acne, acne scars, pigmentation disorders or any skin disease. Repairs, heals or regenerates skin cells. Permanent results, or results without continued use. Completely safe for everyone, or safe during pregnancy. Comparative or superlative claims, such as "stronger than any other ampoule".
Q: How much is it? A: List price S$42.00. Live broadcast price S$32.00. Set with Hydra Barrier Cream S$62.00.
Q: How much niacinamide does it contain? A: 4%.
Q: Can I use it with vitamin C? A: Yes. Apply the vitamin C product first, wait until it is absorbed, then apply the ampoule.
Q: Is it sticky? A: No. The watery-gel texture absorbs quickly. Follow with a moisturiser.
Q: Can I use it in the morning? A: Yes. Use it morning and night. In the morning, follow with moisturiser and sunscreen.
Q: Can I use it while pregnant or breastfeeding? A: The product has not been specifically tested on pregnant or breastfeeding women. Please consult your doctor before use.
